components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single most likely action in a view. One per surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; background: #007AFF; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; touch-action: manipulation; transition: transform 0.12s ease, background 0.12s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0069DB; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #007AFF; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.95); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The default control. Hairline border, quiet until touched.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid #D1D1D6; border-radius: 10px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #1D1D1F; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; touch-action: manipulation; transition: transform 0.12s ease, background 0.12s ease, border-color 0.12s ease, color 0.12s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #F5F5F7; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #007AFF; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: #DCEBFF; color: #007AFF; transform: scale(0.95); }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Clear All, delete. Red text on white, never a red fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid #D1D1D6; border-radius: 10px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #FF3B30; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s ease; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: #FFECEC; } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF3B30; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tool Row
components.description: Signature component: the vertical rail's row. Label wraps to two lines, never truncates. Active state is a full blue fill.
components.css: .ds-toolrail { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; width: 190px; } .ds-toolrow { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; width: 100%; min-height: 44px; height: auto; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid #D1D1D6; border-radius: 10px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #1D1D1F; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; touch-action: manipulation; transition: transform 0.12s ease, background 0.12s ease, border-color 0.12s ease, color 0.12s ease; } .ds-toolrow-icon { display: flex; width: 26px; flex-shrink: 0; justify-content: center; } .ds-toolrow-label { flex: 1; min-width: 0; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-toolrow:hover { background: #F5F5F7; } .ds-toolrow:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #007AFF; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-toolrow:active { transform: scale(0.95); background: #DCEBFF; color: #007AFF; } .ds-toolrow--active { background: #007AFF; border-color: #007AFF; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-toolrow--active:hover { background: #007AFF; }

components.name: Icon-Only Tool Row
components.description: The collapsed rail on narrow viewports. Exactly 44x44 — the silhouette a coach learns with their thumb.
components.css: .ds-toolrail-io { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; align-items: center; } .ds-toolrow-io { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; padding: 0; border: 1px solid #D1D1D6; border-radius: 10px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #1D1D1F; cursor: pointer; touch-action: manipulation; overflow: hidden; transition: transform 0.12s ease, background 0.12s ease, border-color 0.12s ease, color 0.12s ease; } .ds-toolrow-io:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #007AFF; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-toolrow-io:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-toolrow-io--active { background: #007AFF; border-color: #007AFF; color: #FFFFFF; }

components.name: Status Toast
components.description: Centred top-anchored pill. aria-live polite; wraps rather than clipping.
components.css: .ds-toast { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; max-width: min(480px, 100% - 24px); padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid #E5E5E5; border-radius: 16px; background: rgba(250,249,247,0.97); color: #1D1D1F; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.45; text-align: center; box-shadow: 0 12px 36px rgba(0,0,0,0.12); }

components.name: Inline Error
components.description: Warm-tinted failure notice for narrow rails where a toast would be missed. Never reduced to a bare icon.
components.html: Screen recording isn’t available on iPhone — record on a Mac or PC.
components.css: .ds-inline-error { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 6px; width: 100%; padding: 8px 6px; border: 1px solid #FCA5A5; border-radius: 10px; background: #FFF7ED; color: #9A3412; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-inline-error svg { flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 1px; } .ds-inline-error p { margin: 0; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.35; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat at rest. Hairline border and tonal step do the separating, not shadow.
components.html:
Forehand — 12 Aug

Contact point 8cm further forward than the March baseline.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 16px; border: 1px solid #D1D1D6; border-radius: 16px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #1D1D1F; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.45; color: #6E6E73; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Hairline field on white; focus is a blue border plus soft ring, never a glow.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid #D1D1D6; border-radius: 10px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #1D1D1F; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #8E8E93; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #007AFF; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,122,255,0.12); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ready Chip
components.description: Coach-confirmed state in the Coach Override chain. Green means a human signed off — never 'good' in the abstract.
components.html: ReadyPending
components.css: .ds-chip-ready { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(52,199,89,0.12); color: #17913D; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-chip-pending { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; margin-left: 8px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: #F2F2F7; color: #6E6E73; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Action Primary Button
components.description: Product-level commit that leaves the workspace: Save Report, Create Player, Start. Dark fill, not blue.

narrative.overview:
AngleMotion is a precision instrument, and an instrument does not compete with what it measures. The chrome is neutral — white panels, graphite text, hairline separators — so that the only saturated colour on screen belongs to the coach's own marks and the athlete's movement underneath them. When a coach draws an angle across a player's shoulder line, that mark must be the loudest thing in the frame. Every decision in this system is downstream of that.

The system is Apple-derived and unapologetic about it. It uses the iOS system palette and the platform font stack, because the product is used one-handed on a phone at the side of a court and on a laptop afterwards, and platform-native conventions are what a coach already knows how to operate under sunlight with three seconds to spare. This is not a stylistic preference borrowed for polish; it is the shortest path to a control that reads correctly at a glance.

Restraint here is structural, not decorative. Surfaces are flat while you work and lift only to say "this floats above your work." Controls hold hairline borders and generous padding and stay quiet until touched. Nothing blurs, nothing glows, nothing animates for its own sake. The interface earns its keep by being unnoticeable — and then by being exactly where the coach expects when they reach for it.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral chrome; a single blue voice used sparingly
Flat at rest, shadow only for floating layers
Platform-native type and colour, light theme only
44px touch targets everywhere — parity between phone and desktop is a product requirement, not a courtesy
Hairline (1px) borders as the default separator, not shadow

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: System Blue is the only colour that means "you can act on this." If a surface needs emphasis and the thing is not interactive, it gets weight or spacing, never blue.

rules.name: The Two Primaries Rule
rules.body: This product has two primary buttons and both are correct. System Blue is the in-workspace tool action — it lives on the analysis surface, where it means "this tool is active." Action Primary (the dark fill) is the product-level commit — Save Report, Create Player, Start — and lives on the player, decoder and report surfaces. Never mix them on one surface, and never use blue for a commit that leaves the workspace.

rules.name: The Two Whites Rule
rules.body: White is two tokens, not one. Panel is what you write on; Text On Fill is what you write with. They share a value and will never diverge in appearance, but they diverge in meaning — and a surface token used for label text is how a system loses the ability to restyle its filled controls later.

rules.name: The Earned Colour Rule
rules.body: Green, red and orange each carry one meaning and are spent only on it: green for coach-confirmed or live, red for destructive, orange for degraded. A hue with no state behind it does not appear.

rules.name: The Hairline-Over-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Structure is drawn with a 1px Separator border. Reach for shadow only when a surface genuinely floats.

rules.name: The Two-Size Rule
rules.body: Inside the app, body copy is 13px and its supporting label is 11px. Reaching for a third in-between size is how a scale rots — 12px, 14px and 15px exist in the codebase today and are drift to be resolved toward 13/11, not precedent to follow.

rules.name: The Weight-First Rule
rules.body: Build hierarchy with weight (500 → 600 → 700) before size. The app surface has very little room; a heavier 13px outranks a lighter 15px and costs no space.

rules.name: The Parity Rule
rules.body: Every capability is reachable on both phone and desktop. Layout may differ; the feature set may not. A control that exists only on desktop is a defect, not a tier.

rules.name: The No-Blur Rule
rules.body: backdrop-filter is banned on any surface over the video. A live blur forces the compositor to re-blur every presented frame, and this is a video product. Four files carry this as a code comment; it is a design rule, not only a performance note.

rules.name: The Flat-Work Rule
rules.body: If a surface is part of the work, it has no shadow. If it has a shadow, it must be dismissible.

rules.name: The 44 Rule
rules.body: No interactive target is under 44px in either dimension. This is a courtside product used one-handed; it is not negotiable, and it outranks density.

dos: Do take every colour from styles/tokens.css via var(--cl-*). The token file is the source of truth; today only ~30 references use it against 1,106 hardcoded hex values, and every new hex literal deepens that gap.
Do keep System Blue for interactive and selected states only — the One Voice Rule.
Do hold 44px minimum touch targets in both dimensions, on desktop as well as phone.
Do wrap label text to a second line instead of truncating or ellipsising it.
Do separate surfaces with a 1px Separator border before considering shadow.
Do use a dark dialog only when it sits over video.
Do give every disabled control an opacity that matches its real state.
donts: Don't tokenize a colour that becomes user state. PRESET_COLORS in ToolPalette.tsx and ContextualStyleBar.tsx are the coach's annotation-drawing swatches: picking one sets drawingOptions.color, which lands on ctx.strokeStyle. A var() there paints nothing and renders the raw token string as the swatch label. Those arrays stay hex.
Don't introduce a red brand accent. Red is destructive and stop, only. The landing page already carries an explicit rejection of the previous off-brand red.

Don't pull colours from Tailwind's default palette. #F59E0B (amber-500), #78716C (stone-500) and bg-blue-600 (#2563EB) are currently leaking in and are all wrong; the unused coach-blue / coach-gray config in tailwind.config.js is dead and should not be revived.
Don't use backdrop-filter on any surface over the video — the No-Blur Rule.
Don't build dark-mode-first chrome. This product is a light theme. The only sanctioned dark surfaces are the video-adjacent overlay scrim and its dialogs.
Don't reintroduce #1A1A1A. It is fully retired: its text uses became Label and its button fills became Action Primary, both #1D1D1F.
Don't add another grey. #E5E5E5, #E5E5EA and #E8E8ED are retired: border uses became Separator (#D1D1D6), fill uses became Fill Inactive (#E5E5EA).
Don't add radii outside 8 / 10 / 16 / 999. The 4px, 6px, 12px and 14px values in the codebase are drift, not scale.
Don't write -apple-system, sans-serif as a shorthand — it drops the Windows and Android fallbacks. Use the full stack, via var(--cl-font).

Don't put a var() token where CSS custom properties don't resolve: an SVG presentation attribute (stroke="…", or a lucide <Icon color={…}> prop), Next's themeColor metadata (it emits a <meta> tag, not CSS), or a canvas 2D context (ctx.fillStyle). In all three a var() fails silently — no error, wrong or stale colour. Keep the hex literal there.
